entities.name: SDH GABA-immunoreactive neurons
aliases: GABAergic neurons in spinal dorsal horn

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: the proportion of GABAergic neurons in left SDH significantly decreased, compared with that in right side on 14th day after SNI (P < 0.05)

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: In group S, compared with the baseline measured 1 day before surgery, MWT on the medial and lateral sides of the rats' left hindpaw decreased significantly on the 7<sup>th</sup>, 14<sup>th</sup>, and 28<sup>th</sup> days after surgery

key_findings: SNI reduced the proportion of GABA-immunoreactive neurons in ipsilateral spinal dorsal horn, significantly only at day 14, with partial recovery by day 28.
SNI produced persistent mechanical allodynia (reduced MWT) at days 7, 14 and 28.
